text:
sara (AE): Quick ask — AcmeHealth POC wants a temporary per-token hosted rate of $0.0006 for a 6-week pilot (~80M tokens). Current list is $0.0012. They also asked to waive the min charge for the first invoice. Can we approve an exception?

matt (SE): Do they need any SLA changes or dedicated capacity?

sara (AE): No dedicated infra. Just cheaper per-token for pilot so their procurement signs. They said budget is strict.

matt (SE): Ok. From infra side no blockers. Just FYI this spikes our short-term token consumption, cache/batch settings should be tuned.

dita (Sales Ops): Please add the request to the pricing tracker and include the exact dates + PO number if available. Link: https://redwood.internal/pricing-tracker (add entry under Q2 pilot overrides).

jeff (Finance): At $0.0006 for 80M tokens that's $48k vs $96k at list — ~48k incremental discount. We can entertain a one-off credit or a tiered override, but we need revenue impact & ARR signal. Can you add expected follow-on commit?

sara (AE): They said possible enterprise rollout in 3–6 months if POC succeeds. No firm commit yet. Procurement asking for the lower per-token to hit internal pilot budget.

kiran (Deals): I'm ok with a conditional override. Proposal: tiered temporary pricing instead of flat cut — first 30M @ $0.0009, next 30M @ $0.0007, remainder @ $0.0006 for the pilot window. Require exec sponsor email confirming intent to evaluate for enterprise license. Also require PO and add a clause that final contract will reflect list pricing unless a follow-on commit is signed.

sara (AE): That could work — buyer would prefer single flat rate but they might accept tiers. I can push for PO + exec note.

legal-bot: automated note — any non-standard pricing must be documented in the deal memo. No legal red flags flagged yet; full SOC/infosec questionnaire still pending.

jeff (Finance): If we do tiers, finance can approve a one-time billing override and rev recognition treat as usage discount. Need approval from revenue ops for billing flow. Max provisional credit cap: $50k.

dita (Sales Ops): If we proceed, I'll create the billing override and the invoice note. Please drop the final numbers into the tracker row.

sara (AE): Two quick operational asks: 1) can we waive the hosted min charge for the first invoice? 2) can we lock the pilot pricing window dates?

kiran (Deals): Waiving the min charge for first invoice is fine if we get PO + exec confirmation. Lock dates: yes, pilot window set to 2026-04-01 -> 2026-05-12 in the pricing tracker.

matt (SE): Reminder to set TTL on KV cache and enable aggressive batching for the pilot to keep unit cost low. I'll share a config snippet after this thread.

sara (AE): I'll collect PO and sponsor email today and update the tracker. Can someone from finance confirm the $50k provisional credit cap is sufficient?

jeff (Finance): Confirmed. If the discount exceeds cap we escalate to revenue leadership.

kiran (Deals): I'll route this to deal desk now and mark as "conditional override — require PO + exec confirmation". Expect final sign-off by EOD. :thumbsup:

dita (Sales Ops): Noted — will prepare billing override and PR.

sara (AE): Thanks all — will post PO and sponsor once I have them. :raised_hands:
